dimensions.label: Income consistency
dimensions.about: How steady your income is from month to month. Swing means how far a typical month is from your average month. A full score needs a swing of 15% or less; the score is zero at 100% or more.
dimensions.measure: Your monthly income swung 3% around its average of USD 2,408 over 6 months.
dimensions.needed: Nothing more is needed here: this area has the full score.

dimensions.label: Profit margin
dimensions.about: How much of what you earn is left after the business expenses you recorded. A full score needs 60% or more left; the score is zero at 0% or less. Only expenses recorded in LanceraOS count. Personal spending and savings are not tracked here.
dimensions.measure: You kept 70% of your income: USD 14,448 received, USD 4,334 spent, USD 10,114 left.
dimensions.needed: Nothing more is needed here: this area has the full score.

dimensions.label: Tax compliance
dimensions.about: Whether your tax basics are in place: an NTN saved (8 points), a PSEB registration number saved (4 points), a payment recorded in the last 90 days (4 points) and an expense recorded in the last 90 days (4 points). The NTN and PSEB number are what you entered; LanceraOS does not check them with FBR or PSEB. PSEB registration is for people who export IT services, so it may not apply to your work.
dimensions.needed: Nothing more is needed here: this area has the full score.

dimensions.label: Income growth
dimensions.about: How your average month compares with your average month in the same number of months before it. A full score needs growth of 30% or more, flat income earns half the points, and a fall of 30% or more scores zero.
dimensions.measure: Your average month was USD 2,408 over the last 6 months, against USD 2,392 over the 6 months before (up 1%).
dimensions.needed: To score higher, grow your average month. At growth of 30% or more you get all 20 points; yours is up 1%.
steps: Your average month was USD 2,408 over the last 6 months, against USD 2,392 over the 6 months before. An average month of USD 2,631 (10% above the earlier months) would raise this area. This is worth about 3 points of your score.

dimensions.label: Client diversity
dimensions.about: How much of your income depends on one payer, using the "Received from" name on your payments. A full score needs your biggest payer to be 30% or less of your named income; the score is zero at 80% or more. This needs a name on at least 70% of your income.
dimensions.measure: Acme Studio paid 28% of the income that has a name (USD 4,045 of USD 14,448). You have 4 named payers.
dimensions.needed: Nothing more is needed here: this area has the full score.
